name: Mercenary
description: The mercenary eschews lofty aspirations of honor and glory and fights almost exclusively for coin. Although they have a cutthroat reputation, there is a simple pragmatism to their motives. Mercenaries fight with whatever weapons and training they can purchase, and do not limit themselves to any particular discipline.
backstoryPrompts: How did you acquire your combat skill?
Do you take pride in your work?
Do you fight for money, for the excitement of battle, or something else?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
coreAbilityDescription: As a result of extensive training, combat feats and maneuvers cost one less training slot to learn.

levelingBonuses.1: gain proficiency in any skill of your choice. This becomes your supporting skill.
levelingBonuses.5: increase your proficiency in {{skills.martial_arts}} and {{skills.medicine}} to expertise.
levelingBonuses.10: increase your proficiency in {{skills.martial_arts}} and {{skills.medicine}} to mastery.
